verdict.rationale: Benchmark Email documents a REST API covering contacts, lists, campaigns, reports and domains, with scoped keys, so the axis applies. The evidence never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger or equivalent machine-readable spec, and the probe found 404s at every common OpenAPI/Swagger path. An API existing, or an llms.txt file existing, is adjacent and does not count as a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
